statements.t: In addition, in April 2026, the Company purchased an office in Orange Beach, Alabama, which is expected to serve as a banking center following the completion of renovations.

Comparing September 30, 2026 to December 31, 2025, the increase in the ACL reflected changes in loan portfolio composition, including more prominent growth in indirect consumer loans, which require higher credit allowances than other loan categories, as well as changes in economic forecasting associated with the Company’s credit forecasting model, including the expected impact of higher inflation and a higher…

Factors beyond our control, such as changes in economic forecasts related to the national economy, changes in consumer behavior, or economic deterioration in service areas in which the Company operates, may negatively and materially affect asset quality and the adequacy of the ACL, as well as the resulting provision for credit losses.

Management continues to evaluate opportunities to add non-interest revenue streams and grow existing streams; however, with the exception of sales of investment securities which cannot be predicted with certainty, significant variation in non-interest income is not expected in the near term.

While management is focused on efforts to streamline business processes and improve the Company’s efficiency levels, the current inflationary environment is expected to put continued upward pressure on non-interest expense.
The Company’s effective tax rate is expected to fluctuate commensurate with the level of these investments as compared to total pre-tax income.
Management anticipates that core deposits will continue to be the Company’s primary source of funding in the future.
Management will continue to monitor deposit levels closely to help ensure an adequate level of funding for the Company’s activities.
Growth in our indirect consumer portfolio continued, while expected project payoffs in multi-family and construction lending contributed to a decrease in total loans.

While the Company has experienced substantial payoffs of real estate loans during 2026 (including construction, multi-family and commercial real estate), the commercial lending team is strategically focused on building and maintaining commercial lending relationships that are expected to assist future loan growth.
The Company also purchased an office in Orange Beach, Alabama, during 2Q2026, which is expected to serve as a banking center following the completion of renovations.

Relative to the Company’s dividend policy, the payment of cash dividends is subject to the discretion of the Board of Directors and will be determined in light of then-current conditions, including the Company’s earnings, leverage, operations, financial conditions, capital requirements and other factors deemed relevant by the Board of Directors.
